# bitbucket_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing workspace group by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_group" "release_managers" {
  slug = "release-managers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug of the group to look up.

### Read-Only

- `auto_add` (Boolean) Whether new workspace members are automatically added to this group.
- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/slug".
- `name` (String) Display name of the group.
- `permission` (String) Default repository permission granted to new members.
